verdict.rationale: The synchronous transcribe endpoint documents explicit limits of 100 MB and two hours for a single file, so a recording of up to two hours is accepted in one request. Batch mode documents no per-file duration or size limits, and the 100 MB cap may constrain long recordings in practice. Missing for 10: documented per-file duration and size limits for batch jobs, support for recordings longer than two hours, and hands-on corroboration of long-file ingestion.

support.subject: As a developer, multi-hour recordings are accepted in a single job, with the maximum duration and file size documented

citations.quote: POST /aiservices/scribe/transcribe accepts a single local audio or video file up to 100 MB and two hours
